description: unique identifier for each movie.
transformation_or_derivation: No change; used as the primary key for each movie per row
notes_or_concerns: should be unique and non-missing

description: The title of each movie.
notes_or_concerns: used to identify movies

description: The original language of each movie.
notes_or_concerns: stored as short language codes, ex: en or fr

description: The release year of each movie.
notes_or_concerns: useful to analyze ratings over time

description: The runtime of each movie in minutes.
notes_or_concerns: 20 movies had zero runtime

description: The budget of each movie in US dollars.
notes_or_concerns: some movies had zero budget and treated as unreported

description: The revenue of each movie in US dollars.
notes_or_concerns: some movies had zero revenue and treated as unreported

description: The popularity score of each movie.
notes_or_concerns: higher values indicate more popular movies

description: The list of genres for each movie.
notes_or_concerns: missing for 35 movies

description: The primary genre of each movie.
notes_or_concerns: missing for 35 movies, represents only one genre when a movie may have several

description: The production companies for each movie.
notes_or_concerns: stored as a list of company names

description: The production countries for each movie.
notes_or_concerns: stored as a list of country names

description: Whether the movie is adult content.
notes_or_concerns: stored as a boolean value

description: The director of each movie.
notes_or_concerns: missing for some movies

description: The top cast members for each movie.
notes_or_concerns: missing for some movies, multiple cast members stored together as text

description: The list of keywords for each movie.
notes_or_concerns: missing for some movies

description: The mean user rating for each movie.
notes_or_concerns: missing when movie has no ratings

description: The number of user ratings for each movie.
transformation_or_derivation: count of ratings grouped by movieId
notes_or_concerns: missing when movie has no ratings

description: The standard deviation of user ratings for each movie.
transformation_or_derivation: standard deviation of ratings grouped by movieId
notes_or_concerns: missing when movie has fewer than 2 ratings

description: Whether the movie is eligible for a rating target.
transformation_or_derivation: True when user_rating_count is at least 20
notes_or_concerns: 20 rating cutoff is the project's chosen minimum

description: Whether the movie has a high user rating.

notes_or_concerns: undefined when movie has less than 20 ratings
